sources.snippet: Welcome to the GitHub repository of the Qwen3.5 open model series, including Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and the latest Qwen3.8. Here, you can find official information about Qwen3.8, post your questions (Issues), and share your ideas with the community (Discussions).

sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next features a 125B -parameter main model, supplemented by an additional 51B N-gram embeddings, with 6B parameters activated per token. Qwen3.6 Building upon the fundamental breakthroughs of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6 prioritizes stability and real-world utility.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.

sources.snippet: For the first time, Qwen3.8 brings a Qwen-Max-class model to open release. Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.8 delivers substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks.
